projects.title: Collision Detection Engine
projects.description:
Experiment simulator of complex robotic instruments with collision detection, built using NVIDIA PhysX API.

Developed during a 3-month internship in the Instrument Control Department at the Institut Laue–Langevin (ILL).

projects.title: Real-time ray tracer
projects.description: Multithreaded real-time ray tracing engine with triangle meshes, spheres and emissive materials. Optimized using a BVH tree with SAH.

projects.title: JPEG Encoder
projects.description:
Image encoder from the PPM to the JPEG format.

It uses the encoding functions of the JPEG standard (downsampling, DCT, zig-zag, quantization, RLE/huffman coding...) while being optimized (loeffler-DCT, pre-calculation...).

projects.title: Particle simulation
projects.description: Particle simulation evolving under physical forces and potentials using the Störmer-Verlet integration method. It includes spatial discretization, Lennard-Jones interactions, and boundary conditions.

projects.title: Deca compiler
projects.description: Compiler for Deca, a sub-language of Java, developed as part of a group project. The compiler generates assembly code for an abstract machine and includes several optimizations.

projects.title: SIR Cellular automata
projects.description:
A cellular automata simulating epidemic propagation using a compartmental model, over time, in a two-dimensional discretized space.

The model takes into account the spatial heterogeneity of population density.

projects.title: Pastèque Duel
projects.description:
It's a Suika-like mobile game coded on Godot. The game features a LAN multiplayer mode for battling friends.

You have to merge fruits until you get a watermelon without them leaving the box.

projects.title: METEOMAN
projects.description:
It's a Godot puzzle game where you control the weather to move your character.

You have to help the character find his legs back in each level, using the different weather events at your disposal.
